profile_text.body:
Uber Technologies, Inc. is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading under the ticker UBER. Its own site describes the Uber platform and apps as tools for earning, eating, commuting, getting a ride, and simplifying business travel. The company also states that it is introducing autonomous vehicles on Uber, describing them as a key part of the future and saying it is partnering with industry leaders on a safety-driven approach that combines autonomous vehicles and drivers.

The material provided does not list any specific AI products or MCP servers for the company. Its stated position on autonomy is limited to the site's description of autonomous vehicles as part of its future plans alongside human drivers.

Among the facts on record, the company has 281 cases in California, the largest such count by state in this data. No lawsuits are listed individually, and no products are tracked.
